newsitem.title: USA: Walgreen in technical assistance pact in Japan.
newsitem.headline: Walgreen in technical assistance pact in Japan.

text.p: Walgreen Co said Wednesday it signed an agreement with a consortium of six Japanese companies led by Itochu Corp to provide technical assistance on the construction of a pharmacy computer operating system in Japan.
Walgreen said it has no initial ownership in the pharmacy operating system company, called RX Network. The agreement includes an option for Walgreen to purchase a share of the company in the future.
Walgreen also said that, contrary to published reports, it is not part of a joint venture to open stores in Japan.
Walgreen operates 2,278 stores in 34 states and Puerto Rico and had 1996 sales of $11.8 billion.
